name: Amorino
description:
To celebrate the arrival of spring, Amorino has collaborated with Nina Ricci perfumes to create a new sorbet with top notes that reflect those of Nina's fragrances. This fragrant sorbet surprises with a lively burst of acidity that comes from a combination of raspberry, Sicilian lemon and mandarin. This enchanting elixir is rounded off with intoxicating Arabian jasmine. Like a forbidden fruit, this limited-edition sorbet is adorned with a Nina Ricci chocolate apple, which is complimentary with any Macaron Al Gelato, and served in a waffle cone.
The sorbets are available at the Amorino boutique in La Vallée Village from 15 April to 30 June 2019

name: Pierre Hermé Paris
description: Heir to four generations of Alsatian bakery and pastry-making tradition, Pierre Hermé began his career at the age of 14 as an apprentice to Gaston Lenôtre. Famous in France, Japan and the United States, the man that Vogue called "the Picasso of Pastry" revolutionized pastry-making with regard to taste and modernity. With "pleasure as his only guide", Pierre Hermé has invented a totally original world of tastes, sensations and pleasures. With his original approach to the profession of pastry chef, he revolutionizes even the most firmly entrenched traditions. For example, he prefers discreet pastry decors and "uses sugar like salt, in other words, as a seasoning to heighten other shades of flavour." Refusing to sit on his laurels, he is always revising his own work, exploring new taste territories andrevisiting his own recipes

name: Gucci
description: Founded in Florence in 1921, Gucci is one of the world’s leading luxury fashion brands, with a renowned reputation for creativity, innovation and Italian craftsmanship.Gucci is part of the Kering Group, a world leader in apparel and accessories that owns a portfolio of powerful luxury brands.

name: Longchamp
description: Longchamp’s handbags, luggage and accessories have a worldwide reputation for craftsmanship and quality, which now extends to shoes and ready-to-wear collections.

name: Montblanc
description:
Guided by the pioneering spirit since 1906, Montblanc revolutionized the culture of writing with breakthrough innovations. Today, the Maison continues to push boundaries and evolve the expression of fine craftsmanship across each of its product categories: the pinnacle of luxury writing instruments, timepieces, leather goods, accessories, fragrances and eyewear. 
With every innovation, Montblanc offers new functionalities and groundbreaking designs imbued with the Maison’s heritage of sophistication and crafted to the highest standards through the skills of its artisans in each of its manufactures whether Hamburg, Germany for its writing instruments, the Swiss Jura in Le Locle and Villeret for its timepieces or Florence, Italy for its leather goods.
Reflecting its ongoing mission to create fine lifetime companions born from the most pioneering ideas, the iconic Montblanc Emblem has become the ultimate seal of performance, innovation, quality and expression of style. With its origins deeply rooted in the culture of handwriting, Montblanc continues to assert its cultural commitment around the world with the creation of wide-ranging initiatives to promote arts and culture in many forms, while honouring the modern day patrons who support the advancement of the arts.

name: Gerard Darel
description: With its ultra-feminine, simple, chic style, Maison Darel has been the byword for French elegance for more than 40 years. Taking his inspiration from iconic figures such as Jackie Kennedy and Marilyn Monroe, Gerard Darel has breathed new life into off-the-peg clothes and joined a small circle of brands that really matter on the international scene. A true tradition of excellence lies behind the Gerard Darel style – every design is original and timeless, transcending fashion and time.

name: Figaret
description:
Since 1968, Figaret Paris cultivates with passion elegance and the art of shirt-making, the pursuit of excellence is manifested in the tradition of its fabrications, the attention to the finest details and finishing, as well as the search for exceptional materials and original patterns.
The Figaret Paris boutiques propose collections of shirts and accessories for men and ladies.
Embroidery workshop at the Figaret Paris boutique.
Figaret Paris, the French shirt maker, is offering a permanent embroidery workshop in the boutique. Personalise your Figaret Paris shirts, jackets and polo shirts with your initials (or any other embroidered message). Prices from €10.

name: Marc Jacobs
description:
Today renowned as the most desirable designer in New York, Marc Jacobs designed his first collection in 1984 with the Marc Jacobs label.
Marc Jacobs's style stayed true to the description done by the designer himself following his first collection : Funk, quirky and sophisticated at the same time. Through his collections Marc Jacobs has explored different themes like retro and the 70's with the desire to showcase a casual women but chic. Marc Jacobs is and stayed the stylist of the chic and elegance. His collections are well known for being refined and feminine as well as unexpected.
With more than 200 freestanding stores across the globe, Marc Jacobs International now includes Women’s and men’s ready-to-wear and accessories, a Children’s line called Little Marc Jacobs, multiple award-winning fragrances, the bookstore Bookmarc and most recently Marc Jacobs Beauty.

name: Pret A Manger
description: The famous gourmet sandwich shop welcomes you throughout the day to eat in or takeaway. Pret offers delicious sandwiches, wraps and salads, all handmade in its kitchen with carefully sourced, natural ingredients, as well as hearty soups, desserts, fresh juices and pastries to be enjoyed with organic coffee prepared by an expert barista.

name: Kids around
description:
Kids around is a store dedicated to famous brands from kids designers.
GIVENCHY, CHLOÉ, BOSS, DKNY, KARL LAGERFELD KIDS, LITTLE MARC JACOBS, TIMBERLAND, ZADIG & VOLTAIRE.
Boys and Girls collections, from 0 to 16 years. Find Childrenswear, accessories and newborn at discounted prices all year long.
Fashion is also for the kids!

name: Coach
description: Coach is a modern American fashion brand with a rich heritage rooted in quality and craftsmanship. All over the world, the Coach name is synonymous with the ease and sophistication of New York style.

name: ZEGNA
description: Italian brand Ermenegildo Zegna provides sharp tailored suits, with cashmere knits, warm overcoats and leather accessories to complete the look. Experts in wool production since 1910, Zegna supplies fine fabrics to other luxury fashion houses. The family business, currently being run by the fourth generation of Zegnas, is famed for its fine wool made-to-measure suits, and since the 1960s also produces ready-to-wear tailoring.

name: Fred Perry
description: Formed in 1952 by the British tennis legend and table tennis champion Fred Perry; the brand has a unique association with British music and streetwear. It continues to create through its design attitude, associations and collaborations; styling that reflects a strong heritage with a contemporary twist.

name: Charles Tyrwhitt
description: Charles Tyrwhitt (think ‘Tyrwhitt’ like 'spirit') has one main philosophy: helping men look and feel good. Since 1986, the brand has been known as 'the shirt expert', and is loved for its craftsmanship, fine fabrics and exemplary customer service, to boot.  The brand’s elevated and versatile pieces are effortless staples for every man’s wardrobe - no matter your style.

name: Lacoste
description:
Life is a beautiful sport
Lacoste was born with a simple action. In 1933, tennis champion René Lacoste cut the sleeves off his shirt to gain ease of movement on the court. The polo came into being, the crocodile too. Behind the simplicity of the gesture is innovation. Ever since, Lacoste reinvents itself with each collection. Between technical performance, minimal style and French elegance: Silhouettes in perfect balance.

name: Baccarat
description: Founded in 1764 and recognised by the prestigious 25 Best Artisans of France organisation, Baccarat is synonymous with a unique savoir-faire and a symbol of the French art of living. Technical innovations, stylistic audacity, exceptional collaborations with elite craftspeople glassblowers, carvers and engravers – Baccarat is a shining light in the world of tableware, lighting, decorative objects, jewellery and crystal. A world of dreams from heirloom treasures to one of a kind masterworks. From the simple to the precious. Forever innovative, always harmonious.

name: Clarins
description:
Clarins and you. A story of love and trust for a life of beauty and well-being. The story of a French family experts in skin care and make-up. Inspired by the science of nature and respectful of the planet.
Listening to you, and offering the best personalized skin solutions for every moment of your life.
Clarins. It’s all about you.

name: Bompard
description:
Soft is the new strong.
Cashmere yarn has woven through the history of Eric Bompard for more than 30 years.
Always seeking excellence, the French maison has unique expertise, combining working with a noble and rare fabric with a constant search for more visual and graphic new knitting stitches.
At Eric Bompard, the colour is essential. More than 1,300 shades have already been created since the brand was created.
Discover women’s, men’s and children’s collections, rich in edgy pieces complementing the already extensive collection of timeless pieces.

name: UGG
description:
Founded in 1978 on the coast of California by an Australian surfer, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot.
First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG® has since expanded beyond the icon to design footwear, apparel, accessories, and home decor with an uncompromising attitude toward creativity, quality and craftsmanship.
Bold, provocative, free-spirited, optimistic, and real, the brand has always celebrated unapologetic individuality and continues to be embraced globally by those who refuse to be defined by convention.

name: Ferragamo
description: Remembered as the maker of exquisite hand-made shoes, Salvatore Ferragamo, moved to America from Italy in 1914, eventually ending up in Hollywood where his repair and shoe-making business began to attract Hollywood stars and movie-makers. His shoes featured on the stars on and off duty (he made Judy Garland’s red shoes for the Wizard of Oz). Returning to Italy in 1927, he set up his eponymous fashion house, which today produces menswear, womenswear, fragrances and eyewears.

name: Ladurée
description: Discover the world-renowned macarons and other desserts at Ladurée in La Vallée Village

name: Burberry
description: Burberry is a luxury British fashion brand. Established in 1856, its founder Thomas Burberry invented gabardine, the lightweight weatherproof fabric that revolutionised rainwear. Gabardine remains at the heart of the brand and is still used to make the iconic Heritage Trench Coat. Today the Burberry name is globally synonymous with design innovation, craftsmanship and a uniquely British sensibility.

name: Bonpoint
description: Rich in the savoir-faire of a couture house, thanks to its artisan studio in Paris, Bonpoint cultivates the precision of beauty, the passion for quality and a meticulous attention to detail and finish. With more than 100 addresses in 27 countries (Paris, Moscow, Saint Petersburg, New York, Sao Paulo, Tokyo, Shanghai, Dubai...). Bonpoint is the French Fashion House for children, unique in its just-so style, poetic universe tinged with humor and magic, subtle delicacy, inspired shop windows and the warm atmosphere of its boutiques and “Maisons” in the heart of Saint-Germain-des-Prés in Paris and on Madison Avenue in New York.

name: Calvin Klein
description: The jeans brand known for both its innovative fit and ground-breaking advertising campaigns, which launched the international careers of the likes of Kate Moss and Mark Wahlberg. Klein could be credited with inventing the designer jeans craze in the 1970s by putting his name on the back pocket.

name: Calvin Klein Underwear
description: Bronx-born Klein started out with a coat shop in the York Hotel in New York City in the 1960s but by the early 70s, he was producing menswear, womenswear and award-winning underwear collections. A household name today, some would say you’re not properly dressed unless you’re wearing Calvin Klein underwear, sporting the distinctive logo.

name: Guess
description: Known for its European styling, upscale image and glamorous collections, GUESS is one of the most widely recognizable brands across the globe with a style that dresses and accessorizes the world with fashionable clothing, handbags, watches, footwear and more. The GUESS collections are always fresh and striking with favourite jeans styles and new fits each season for both him and her, constantly affirming the brand’s Denim DNA. The sexy, young and adventurous image envisaged by founders Maurice and Paul Marciano when they founded the company in 1981 has been depicted for almost 30 years in the award-winning and inspirational advertising campaigns that have made GUESS a household name.

name: Balenciaga
description: Balenciaga offers women’s and men’s ready-to-wear, handbags, shoes, accessories and eyewear.

name: Yves Salomon
description:
With a long history of excellence and total control of every step from creation to production in his workshop in Paris, Yves Salomon is a major actor in the revival of fur. Now that his son is following in his footsteps, the company is sharing its tradition and savoir-faire across the world.
Collections: Womenswear, Accessories, Menswear, Kidswear

name: Samsonite
description: Whether you're going on holiday, preparing for a business trip or simply shopping for something new, the Samsonite boutique has it all. Suitcases of all sizes, computer bags, roller bags, luggage for children and travel accessories – you will find the perfect item.

name: Loro Piana
description:
Loro Piana is committed to quality, high-performance textile innovation and imbuing each of its designs with timeless Italian elegance.

Founded in 1924, Loro Piana is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of fine fabrics, later adding luxurious clothing and quality accessories to its offering.

name: Tory Burch
description: Tory Burch is an American lifestyle brand that inspires people around the world to live in full color with character, beauty and confidence.  The collection embodies the personal style and sensibility of its Executive Chairman and Chief Creative Officer, Tory Burch. It includes ready-to-wear, shoes, handbags, accessories, watches, home and fragrance.

name: Claudie Pierlot
description:
Claudie Pierlot has always expressed its vision of Parisian chic with stylistic risks and a sophisticated taste for beautiful materials and details. The schoolgirl collar, the striped shirt and the bow tie are all signatures of the brand's aesthetic and create instantly recognisable collections.
The brand's timeless classics are updated in step with trends for a feminine feel and an impertinent touch. All over the world, Claudie Pierlot represents the lightness and style of Paris that is subtle, strong, on-trend and always chic.

name: Tissot
description: TISSOT has recently joined La Vallée Village, where it harmoniously expands the Village's varied selection. The brand's high-end watches are another reason why those of any taste or age can find something for them at the Village. Discover the pure and contemporary design of the label's first outlet boutique, where you'll be treated to an encounter with TISSOT's iconic timepieces. They deftly bring together luxury and high technology, as the brand has been at the avant-garde of innovation since its creation in 1853. Welcome to a world where elegant timekeeping in within reach, don't wait to explore it for yourself. Discover the collections at Tissot and Hour Passion.

name: Vilebrequin
description: A sharp-eyed observer of the privileged bathers on the French Riviera beach fashioned the first ever boxer short swimming trunks from the chequered cloth on his café table. When the inventor hit upon a quick-drying spinnaker canvas, the car enthusiast named the results of his innovation Vilebrequin, meaning “crankshaft“. His upmarket swimwear won the loyalty of the St Tropez set and can now be found on every exclusive beachside in the world.

name: Max Mara
description: Max Mara was founded as a menswear business in post-war Italy by Achille Maramotti, who soon found himself making clothes for women who loved high fashion but couldn’t afford it. His ethos - providing high quality, design-forward clothing at more reasonable prices - has culminated, a half-century later, with Max Mara’s reputation for classic clothes and luxurious materials, with a special talent for knitwear. Celebrity fans include Sandra Bullock, Daisy Fuentes and Joely Richardson.

name: Isabel Marant
description:
Say Isabel Marant, think Parisian flow.
Having founded her label in ’94, she instantly became renowned for her pioneering and cosmopolitan spirit bringing self-affirmation and feel good effect to her dégaine..
To do so, ever since her launch, she has been trying on each garment before it leaves her studio to ensure everything works in the everyday life of a real woman.

name: Levi’s®
description: A classic since right now. Meet the only jeans you’ll ever need! Since invented in 1873, the Levi’s® Jean has been a blank canvas for self-expression. Always original. Today, Levi’s® continues to evolve through a relentless innovative spirit. Visit the Levi’s® store now and find your new favorite pair of Levi’s® at special outlet prices. Express your personal style and show the world how you Live in Levi’s®.

name: Polo Ralph Lauren Children
description: Polo Ralph Lauren Children is designed to reflect the timeless heritage and modern spirit of Ralph Lauren’s collections for men and women. Signature classics, including iconic polo knit shirts and luxurious cashmere cable sweaters, are interpreted in the most sophisticated and vibrant colours.

name: Tommy Hilfiger
description:
A globally recognised lifestyle brand, Tommy Hilfiger’s signature flag logo symbolises high-end quality that customers worldwide associate with luxury and quintessential American prep. The launch of their iconic men’s sportswear range in 1985 led to the expansion of the brand’s clothing range to encompass a complete premium collection for men, women, and kids. Today, in its 30th year, Tommy Hilfiger dresses the whole family and is a much-loved fashion brand.
Collections: Women, Men, Children
Discover your favourite brands – including Tommy Hilfiger – at La Vallée Village, which offers more than 130 boutiques with exceptional savings.

name: Versace
description: Founded in 1978, Versace is one of the leading global fashion design houses. Under the artistic direction of Donatella Versace since 1997, Versace designs, manufactures, distributes and retails fashion and lifestyle products including haute couture, women's and men's ready-to-wear, jewellery, watches, accessories, fragrances and furniture.

name: Prada
description:
Since 1913, Prada is synonymous of an unmistakable style which has always anticipated, and often oriented, new trends in all fields. 
Collections: Womenswear, Menswear, Accessoiries, Miu Miu

name: Sunglass Hut
description: Sunglass Hut’s mission is to be the premier shopping and inspiration destination for top eyewear brands, offering the latest trends and exclusive styles. Discover collections from famous brands such as: Ray-Ban, Persol, Burberry, Bulgari, Dolce & Gabbana, Emporio Armani, Oakley and Vogue. Find the perfect pair at Sunglass Hut in La Vallée Village!

name: BOSS
description:
Hugo Boss offers sophisticated collections that are focused on quality and design, creating an impeccable look whether it’s for work or leisure.
Collections: Menswaer, Womenswear, Accessories

name: Berenice
description:
The high-end French ready-to-wear brand Berenice has been recognized as a benchmark for chic basics.

Frédéric Krief founded the label in 2004. The label uses superior materials such as cashmere, silk and satin in a romantic palette but at an affordable price point. Shoes and accessories complete the girly look.

name: L'Occitane en Provence
description: At L'Occitane, treat yourself with the best of Provence beauty, where every ingredient is synonymous with authenticity, respect and a sensorial experience.

name: Diesel
description:
DON’T NEED TO REMOVE YOUR JOGGJEANS, IT SAYS THAT YOU CAN EVEN SLEEP WITH IT...
Usually you take jeans off when you get home. JoggJeans give you extra comfort, don’t take them off just sleep in them.
The essence of Diesel’s revolutionary denim, soft and comfortable as a pair of sweatpants with the high quality and durability of denim provides dream-like comfort in any circumstances. JoggJeans are so comfortable that they really become “The jeans of your dreams”.
Diesel is not just about a pair of jeans. It’s a statement on individuality and self-expression, a battle cry for innovation, artistry and technical expertise driven by the belief that passion is the greatest muse. Renzo Rosso founded Diesel in 1978, creating a lifestyle brand rooted in denim but forged by an unwavering visions for the future.

name: Timberland
description: Today Timberland outfits consumers from toe-to-head, with versatile collections rooted into the brand’s rich heritage of utility, craftsmanship and style. Timberland’s dedication to making quality products is matched by an unwavering commitment to innovate and operate in a responsible manner – in terms of our products, the outdoors, and the communities around the globe where we live, work and explore.

name: Armani
description: In 1975 Giorgio Armani founded his company in Milan. Since then, he has established his name as a world leader in fashion and accessory design with his brands Emporio Armani and Armani Exchange . His style is synonymous with luxury and contemporary elegance, modernity, and sophistication.

name: Furla
description:
Furla is a premium accessories brand whose style codes are defined by an upbeat and inspiring Italian lifestyle. A fusion of contemporary design, top quality craftsmanship and an upbeat edge that make the difference.
Made with the finest Italian leather, Furla’s pieces are unique and innovative offering contemporary designs injected with a playful, colourful and joyful edge. Since 1927, Furla engages and inspires women across the board.

It’s Love at first sight – Meet FURLA BELLA
These unique staples allow you to express yourself with fun designs that don’t go unnoticed. Both designs feature stitching on tone that outlines the playful message and a pretty closure that makes for a luxe detail. Versatile and functional, they can be both used as a shoulder bag and a crossbody.

name: Sandro
description:
This young label from France gives women and men effortless chic with fashion that manages to be ultra-hip, romantic and voluptuous all at once. Founded by Evelyne Chétrite in 2005, it opened its first boutique on rue Vieille du Temple, Paris, the brand now has outlets all over France, providing wearable, casual fashion and accessories with a bohemian air.
Collections: Womenswear, Menswear and Accessories

name: Anne Fontaine
description: French designer Anne Fontaine is the creator of the ultimate white shirt. A true tribute to femininity, she adapts her creations to suit all personalities and a multitude of occasions.

name: ba&sh
description: The brainchild of childhood friends, Parisians Barbara Boccara and Sharon Krief, who were looking for unfussy, everyday, chic clothes – the clothes they would like to wear themselves. The simple, stylish wardrobe staples have attracted many fashion insiders who want to wear them too.

name: Polo Ralph Lauren Men and Women
description:
Authentic and iconic, Polo Ralph Lauren Men and Women is the original symbol of the modern preppy lifestyle. Combining Ivy League classics and time-honored English haberdashery with downtown styles and All-American sporting looks, Polo sportswear and tailored clothing present a one-of-a-kind vision.
Collections: Womenswear, Menswear, Accessories

name: Tod's
description: An Italian brand that produces shoes and other luxury leather goods like bags and accessories. Dorino Della Valle began a shoemaking business out of a basement in the twenties, and his son Diego made the Tod’s name when he developed its signature shoe, the Gommino moccasin-casual and handmade, with 133 rubber pebbles on the sole. Made in Italy, the artisanship behind the brand’s footwear and accessories guarantees quality and careful design.

name: Maje
description:
Parisian girls love Maje, home of sleek leather leggings, romantic blouses, cashmere dresses and fitted silk t-shirts. Since designer Judith Milgrom opened her first store in the fashionable Saint Germain district, her beautifully designed and cleverly tailored collections have inspired women all over the world. From ostrich feather skirts to delicate tiered ruffle blouses, Maje provides daring, chic womenswear.
Collections: Womenswear, Accessories

name: Givenchy
description: Since spring 2017, Clare Waight Keller has been the artistic director of Haute Couture and women’s and men’s ready-to-wear. With her debut show, on October 1st 2017, Clare Waight Keller established a forward-looking new signature for the house of Givenchy based on the idea of Light in darkness.

name: Valentino
description: Vision, products, retail spaces share the same traits: from the one-of-a-kind Haute Couture creations to women’s and men’s ready-to-wear and accessories, from eyewear to fragrances to the boutiques, Valentino is synonymous of elegance, pureness, craftsmanship, uniqueness.

name: Zadig&Voltaire
description:
“THIS IS ROCK, THIS IS ZADIG !“
Zadig & Voltaire is all about casual-chic: it is a state of mind, a musical inclination, fashion as a bold statement. With rock’n’roll in its blood and art as its inspiration, the brand has naturally become a “concept store” ahead of its time. In stores, its collections are accompanied by music compilations from the brand’s label. It is art and luxury at an affordable price: this was Thierry Gillier’s vision.
A best-seller, for comfort and an ultra-flattering attitude that accents the waist and enshrines the knit like a separate piece of clothing whose cut finally comes into play.

name: Jimmy Choo
description: Jimmy Choo encompasses a complete collection of women’s shoes, handbags, small leather goods, sunglasses, eyewear, fragrance and men’s shoes and accessories.

name: Villeroy & Boch
description: With a 260-year ceramics heritage, Villeroy & Boch produces sleek, contemporary, home products. Founded in 1748 by François Boch in a small village in the Lorraine region of France, the pottery company crossed the border into Luxembourg before settling in Mettlach, Germany. There the brand merged with that of Nicolas Villeroy and made its name with the innovative design that characterises its collections to this day, from cutlery and tableware to wellness and bathroom accessories.

name: Hour Passion
description: Hour Passion is a specialist watch boutique, housing some of the most exciting and globally revered « Swiss Made » brands to include LONGINES, RADO, TISSOT, BALMAIN, MIDO and HAMILTON. Hour Passion prominently houses each brand in its own individual retail space, allowing you a closer look at the brands’ unique features. Make time for Hour Passion and marvel at your next extraordinary timepiece.

name: Hackett London
description:
Founded by Jeremy Hackett in 1983, Hackett London has become a global leader in menswear, blending timeless British style with modern sophistication. 
Collections: Menswear, Accessories

name: Lancel
description: Since its creation, Lancel – which celebrated its 140th anniversary in 2016 – continues to surprise, predicting trends and creating iconic accessories such as supple luggage and the bucket bag.

name: Dolce & Gabbana
description: The quintessence of Italian glamour, Dolce&Gabbana has defined a new kind of luxury. The strong identity of the Dolce&Gabbana brand has evolved over the years without ever forgetting its roots; an unmistakable style, which, season after season, combines true innovation with the Mediterranean flavour of its origins. Modern yet classic, luxurious yet unconventional, the essence of Dolce&Gabbana is defined by its contrasting features.

name: Chloé
description: French fashion house, Chloé was founded in 1952 by Gaby Aghion, an Egyptian-born Parisienne with a bohemian spirit. Rejecting the stiff formality of 1950s haute couture, she created soft, alluring clothes from the finest fabrics. The brand is both independent and bold, with an acute sense of beauty. Today, is Chloé’s Creative Director, bringing her unique vision to the forefront and embodying an elegant femininity with her designs.

name: Michael Kors
description:
Michael Kors is a world-renowned, award-winning designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear. His namesake company, established in 1981, is an influential global presence with over 500 stores in more than 85 countries worldwide, as well as wholesale distribution to top department stores worldwide. The brand currently produces a range of products under the signature Michael Kors Collection and Michael Kors labels. These products include accessories, footwear, watches, jewelry, men's and women's ready-to-wear, swimwear, eyewear and a full line of fragrance products. With an innate sense of glamour, Michael Kors offers a luxury lifestyle for the consummate jet setter that is as sophisticated as it is indulgent and as iconic as it is modern. Capsule Collection
Get ready for the new term with stylish new arrivals at the Michael Kors boutique, including Jet Set Totes from E129.

name: Moncler
description: Moncler is synonymous with quality outerwear and most famous for its celebrated down jackets. The skiwear brand’s name comes from Monastier de Clermont, a mountain village near Grenoble, France where, in 1952, Réné Ramillon created the down jacket to keep his factory workers warm. Today, Moncler combines technical expertise and quality with style to produce clothes that are suited as much to the mountains as the city.

name: KENZO
description: The fashion house of KENZO was started in 1970 as Jungle Jap, a boutique in Paris at Galerie Vivienne where the founder Kenzo Takada, sold his handmade women's collection. The flagship KENZO store was opened at 3 Place des Victoires in 1976, and the brand expanded into a full Parisian fashion house. KENZO debuted its first men’s ready-to-wear collection in 1983, and its kids and home collections in 1987, followed by KENZO fragrances in 1988. In 1993, KENZO joined the LVMH Group. In 1999, KENZO marked its 30th anniversary and the retirement of its Artistic Director Kenzo Takada. In July 2011, Carol Lim & Humberto Leon, founders of the OPENING CEREMONY fashion retail stores and private label collection were appointed Creative Directors of KENZO. Using the brand’s DNA, the duo have given KENZO their take on the revolutionary spirit with which the brand was founded. In July 2012, Humberto and Carol reintroduced the jungle to the KENZO brand.

name: Concierge Services
description: Hands-Free Shopping Collection Point

name: Golden Goose
description:
Golden Goose was born in 2000 merging the creative spirit of Francesca Rinaldo and Alessandro Gallo: two young Venetian designers, outsiders until then to the world of fashion. Since the beginning, the company has distinguish itself with innovative but artisan spirited products, a low-key communication strategy and a highly selective placement in venues that share the brand's philosophy. 

Golden Goose has created a complete lifestyle for its customers, offering a collection that includes ready to wear, accessories and footwear, combining a refined and modern style with a vintage feeling, all supported by the strong Italian sartorial tradition.

name: Repetto
description:
Repetto lends its unique imagination to a wide range of exclusive products, including shoes, leather goods, athleisure and classical dancewear. The brand’s collections play with colour and different materials to entice an elegant and modern female customer.
Its products are designed in the Dordogne, in historical ateliers where Repetto’s expertise and desire for excellence are upheld.

name: KARL LAGERFELD
description:
The house of KARL LAGERFELD shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its founder, KARL LAGERFELD, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.
The brand celebrates his colossal legacy and breathes his passion, intuition and inexhaustible creativity into the core of its DNA.
The signature KARL LAGERFELD aesthetic combines Parisian classics with a rock-chic attitude and tailored silhouettes. Its portfolio of accessible, aspirational collections includes ready-to-wear for women, plus bags, small leather goods and footwear.

name: Balmain
description: Its collections, which feature richly embroidered fabrics and nipped-in waists, are characterised by Balmain’s signature silhouette of the jolie madame – or ‘pretty lady’. While the house famously remains true to the trailblazing vision of its founder, today Creative Director Olivier Rousteing’s couture spirit – seen in his careful attention to detail – is balanced by the collections’ modernity.

name: Brunello Cucinelli
description: Founded in 1978 by the eponymous stylist and entrepreneur, Brunello Cucinelli’s success is rooted in the history and legacy of great craftsmanship as well as in modern design. A symbol of Italian lifestyle worldwide, Brunello Cucinelli is based in the medieval hamlet of Solomeo, on the outskirts of Perugia. Distributed internationally in more than 60 countries worldwide, the brand continues to convey both creativity and craftsmanship through its innovative collections.

name: J.M. Weston
description:
J.M. Weston has been the benchmark in the world of French luxury footwear for men since 1891.

Its traditional skills, passed down in the famous “Goodyear” welt, are practised by over 170 artisans at the J.M. Weston factory in Limoges. The House counts 39 stores around the world, and whether in France or abroad, it has always reflected a French elegance that intersects freely with a timeless spirit and contemporary influences. Olivier Saillard is Artistic, Image and Culture Director of J.M. Weston, and Thierry Oriez has been Chairman since 2014.

name: Fendi
description:
The house of Fendi was established by Adele and Edoardo Fendi in Rome in 1925. The opening of the first Fendi boutique, followed by a handbag shop and fur workshop, soon won the brand international acclaim, Fendi emerged as a name renowned for its elegance, craftsmanship, innovation and style. 

Today Fendi is synonymous with quality, tradition, experimentation and creativity.

name: Stone Island
description: Founded in 1982, Stone Island is the symbol of extreme research in fibers and textiles, applied to an innovative design. The Italian man sportswear brand developed an unique capacity to work on the finished garment, via continuous experimentation with dyes and treatments.

name: Claris Virot
description:
Launched in 2014 after a trip to Bali, leather goods brand Claris Virot offers accessible luxury accessories collections crafted from premium materials, including vegetable-tanned and exotic leathers. 

Colour is at the heart of the brand’s creative process, which has evolved and diversified over the years. With vibrant hues, practical sizes and exceptional craftsmanship, Claris Virot is a reflection of the contemporary, ever-evolving world of fashion.

name: The North Face
description: Today it is one of the world’s leading outdoor brands, creating athlete-tested, expedition-proven items that help people explore and test the limits of human potential.

name: Christian Louboutin
description:
Internationally renowned for his iconic red soles, Christian Louboutin celebrates empowerment & diversity with his eclectic and playful designs.

Christian Louboutin is one of the world’s most well-known shoe-designers. He established his business in the heart of Paris in 1991, first with a collection for Women’s shoes followed a few years later by one for Men, both recognizable by the signature red lacquered sole. His designs share a luxurious aesthetic of playfulness, Parisian chic and unique craftmanship. With a prolific collection of women’s and men’s shoes, handbags and small leather goods, Christian Louboutin celebrates empowerment and diversity.

name: Le Salon
description: The new home for the Village boutiques’ pop-up sales, where you’ll find a range of irresistible offers, exclusives and more from some of your favourite brands, each for a limited time only.

name: Ami Paris
description:
Born in Paris in 2011, inspired by Paris ever since - AMI offers stylish and comprehensive wardrobes for men and women, blurring the boundaries between casual and chic.

The name AMI, the French word for friend, plays with the initials of Alexandre Mattiussi, its founder and creative director. AMI captures a particular type of the French capital's nonchalance, one that is young, cool and carefree. Standing for a relaxed, authentic and friendly approach to fashion. AMI was awarded the prestigious ANDAM prize in 2013.

name: Fusalp
description:
Since 1952, Fusalp conveys the idea of a dynamic silhouette, French elegance and the pledge of a sporty yet slender line, inspired by alpine skiing. 

It is the idea that you can combine performance and comfort without sacrifying on style and cut.

name: The Cosmetics Company Store
description: As part of the Estée Lauder Companies, The Cosmetics Company Store offers award-winning premium skincare, make-up and fragrance products from a collection of prestigious brands including Estée Lauder, Clinique and Bobbi Brown.

name: ZIMMERMANN
description: ZIMMERMANN, Founded in Sydney in 1991 by Sisters Nicky and Simone Zimmermann. ZIMMERMANN believes in a relaxed femininity, in nonchalant sophistication and a graceful joie de vivre. The collections are fresh, design-driven, sophisticated and feminine, optimistic with a casual sexiness. ZIMMERMANN remains proud of the Australian heritage and celebrates its new cultural dexterity but are not defined by it. The narrative is global, though the roots will always remain firmly embedded in Australia.

name: McQueen
description:
McQueen’s collections combine an in-depth working knowledge of bespoke British tailoring, fine workmanship and the impeccable finish of Italian manufacturing. 
Alexander McQueen shows are known for their emotional power and raw energy, as well as the romantic but determinedly contemporary nature of the collections. Integral to the McQueen culture is the juxtaposition between contrasting elements: fragility and strength, tradition and modernity, fluidity and severity. An openly emotional and even passionate viewpoint is realised with a profound respect and influence for the arts and crafts tradition.

name: Wild & The Moon
description:
Wild & The Moon is a movement created by à tribe of life enthusiasts, nature lovers, and food enthusiasts, including chefs, nutritionists, and naturopaths.

They seek to share their way of life and believe that real food is the one that is good for oneself, good for the planet, and delicious.

The ambition of our Wild Tribe is to bring local, seasonal ingredients to our urban communities, sourced from responsible trade whenever possible, promoting biodiversity.

We aim to revive traditional food preparation techniques to protect their vitality, enhance their nutritional powers, and offer the benefits of raw foods and the unaltered taste of bioactive elements.

We embrace the benefits of Mother Nature, sourced entirely from the plant kingdom, free from hormones and cruelty. We tap into the healing power of nature and offer it to city dwellers, nourishing their souls and reigniting smiles through the powerful alchemy of plants.

name: Axel Arigato
description: Axel Arigato was launched with one main objective: to embrace the now and always look for the tomorrow. Known for its breakdown and shattering of the traditional seasonal calendar, through its unique system of weekly drops; Axel Arigato serves a type of interest that's percussive, following a cultural cadence rather than an industry one. Founded in 2014, as a direct-to-consumer brand, Axel Arigato has physical stores in six countries across Europe and UAE and is present online in 134 territories worldwide. Harnessing the energy of the next generation through a multi directional lens, Axel Arigato exists to be a positive platform for all.

name: Momus
description: Delight in a celebration of coffee at Momus when you enjoy your beverage in the café or to take away. From rare Arabicas to designer editions and single-origin varieties, fine coffee connoisseurs can find joy in a symphony of aromatic notes and intensities.

name: Acne Studios
description: Discover Acne Studios collections of men’s and women’s ready-to-wear, footwear, accessories and denim in boutique at La Vallée Village.

name: Beauté Prestige International
description: NARS, Shiseido, Narciso Rodriguez and many other leading cosmetics brands await you at the Beauté Prestige International boutique in La Vallée Village.

name: K-Way
description:
K-Way embodies practical elegance, offering collections for men, women and children that combine style and functionality.  

Known for revolutionising rainwear since 1965, the brand is a key player in outdoor fashion, combining premium quality with innovation.

name: TUMI
description: Discover Tumi collections at reduced prices in La Vallée Village. As the leading international brand of business, lifestyle and travel accessories, Tumi is committed to offering premium products created under founding principles of excellence in design.

name: Rabanne
description:
An innovative fashion house as singular today as when it was founded in 1966, Rabanne 
stands out for unifying an avant-garde vision with modern values. Since the earliest 
collections through the 1960s and ‘70s, the Paris-based brand has explored ideas 
of radical craft—from the use of metal mesh as fabric that contours the body, 
to assemblages of unconventional materials that create kinetic silhouettess.

name: Miu Miu
description:
Founded in 1993, Miu Miu embodies the unconventional and heartfelt point of view of Miuccia Prada.

Miu Miu celebrates and empowers women – celebrates and empowers humanity.

Shop Miu Miu's collections at the Prada boutique in La Vallée Village.

name: Church's
description: Discover Church’s classic British designer shoes in Prada boutique at La Vallée Village.

name: Hogan
description:
Sophisticated accessories and clothing, with an essential, innovative design and the perfect combination of function and informal elegance, made in top-quality materials.

Find Hogan in the Tod's boutique at La Vallée Village.

name: BYREDO
description: Discover the Swedish luxury brand BYREDO and its range of perfumes and make-up products at La Vallée Village.

name: Jacquemus
description: Discover the French luxury brand Jacquemus and its unique ready-to-wear collections and accessories at La Vallée Village.

name: Watchfinder & Co.
description: Watchfinder & Co. brings to La Vallée Village its wealth of expertise and experience in the luxury pre-owned watch sector.

name: BIRKENSTOCK
description: The Original BIRKENSTOCK Footbed is an ergonomic masterpiece, designed to replicate the mindful experience of walking barefoot. Shaped to follow the natural contours of the foot. For stability, arch support, and effortless motion with every step.

name: Hands-Free Shopping
description: Relax while we collect and pack your purchases, ready for you to pick up when you leave.

name: L'Artisan Parfumeur
description: Discover L’Artisan Parfumeur, exceptional fragrances & French art de vivre, at La Vallée Village.

name: lululemon
description: lululemon is a Canadian performance apparel brand that puts feel at the heart of everything it does.

name: Diptyque
description: Born in 1961 in the artistic effervescence of Paris’s Saint‑Germain-des-Prés district, Diptyque creates evocative personal and home fragrances, scented skincare and decorative objects. Blending reverie, nature and art, the Maison opens the doors to a vibrant universe where the imagination is free to roam.

name: VEJA
description: Discover VEJA at La Vallée: eco-responsible sneakers since 2005, innovative materials, and ethical manufacturing in Brazil and Portugal.

name: On
description: On was born in the Swiss Alps with one goal: to revolutionise the sensation of running by empowering all to run on clouds.

name: Café Lapérouse
description: The French art of hospitality has found its new address at La Vallée Village. An exceptional setting in which to enjoy refined and flavourful French cuisine.
